name: Promocodes.com
description: Promocodes.com helps users quickly find active promo codes and deals for online stores directly inside Claude. Ask for a brand or merchant (for example, “Lovehoney coupons” or “Hotels.com deals”), and the connector returns organized results with promo codes, no-code deals, and clickable action links like Use code, View code, and Get deal.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Promocodes.com to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Promocodes.com to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://claude-app.promocodes.com/mcp.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Promocodes.com MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Promocodes.com provides these MCP tools: show_content and get_coupons.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Promocodes.com?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Promocodes.com in e-commerce on the Manufact MCP catalog include Figaro Immobilier, Shop, eYantra Corporate Gifting, Get My eSIM, and Is It Legit by M8ven.
Promocodes.com does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
Promocodes.com is developed by Surfmyads.com, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
